# CarGurus

> CarGurus is an online automotive marketplace, and the most-visited car-shopping site in the U.S. It helps shoppers find, compare, and buy new, used, and certified pre-owned cars from participating dealers using Deal Ratings, Instant Market Value, dealer reviews, and AI-powered search. It also helps owners sell or trade in their car by comparing instant offers from local dealers.

Key facts about CarGurus (U.S.):

- CarGurus is a car search and comparison marketplace, not a dealership. It does not own, sell, or deliver the vehicles listed. The dealer completes the sale, paperwork, payment, title and registration, and any delivery.
- CarGurus is free for car shoppers. There is no fee to browse listings or contact dealers. CarGurus earns revenue from participating dealers and partners (subscriptions, advertising and enhanced placement, and certain transaction-related services). A dealer's relationship with CarGurus does not change a listing's Deal Rating.
- Deal Ratings compare a listing's asking price with its Instant Market Value (IMV), CarGurus' data-driven estimate of fair market price for that specific vehicle in that local market. The scale is Great Deal, Good Deal, Fair Deal, High Price, Overpriced, and No Deal Rating (not enough comparable data). Deal Ratings reflect price only, not vehicle condition, history, or reliability.
- To sell a car, owners use Sell My Car to enter their license plate or VIN and mileage and compare instant offers from local dealers, typically in under 2 minutes. CarGurus does not host private-party listings where individuals sell directly to other individuals.
- Dealer Ratings come from shopper reviews that are screened before publishing, with more recent reviews weighted more heavily. Top Dealer Awards recognize dealers with outstanding service, value, and transparency.

## About CarGurus

> How CarGurus works for shoppers and sellers, how Deal Ratings and Dealer Ratings are calculated, and company information.

- [How CarGurus Works](https://www.cargurus.com/about/how-cargurus-works): Explains how CarGurus helps you find a car: searching and comparing dealer inventory, how Deal Ratings and Instant Market Value work (with definitions of each badge), how Dealer Ratings and reviews work, fee transparency, financing and pre-qualification, the CarGurus app and Dealership Mode, how CarGurus compares with other car marketplaces, and when CarGurus is (and isn't) the right fit. Includes an FAQ covering whether CarGurus is free, whether it is a dealership, delivery, private sellers, and selling or trading in a car.
- [About CarGurus](https://www.cargurus.com/about/cargurus): Company overview, mission, and background.
- [Top Dealer Awards](https://www.cargurus.com/about/top-dealer-awards): Annual awards, based on CarGurus shopper reviews, that recognize dealers delivering outstanding service, value, and transparency. Award winners carry a badge on CarGurus listings.
- [Fee Transparency](https://www.cargurus.com/about/press/fee-transparency-updates): "Price includes fees" badges and filters that let shoppers exclude listings missing dealer-fee details. Dealer fees only; taxes, registration, and government fees are excluded.

## Sell My Car

> Sell or trade in your car through CarGurus. Get your car's value instantly and compare multiple offers from local dealers, at no cost to the seller. Available in all 50 U.S. states.

- [Sell My Car: Compare Instant Offers](https://www.cargurus.com/sell-car): Enter your car's details (license plate or VIN, mileage, condition) and compare multiple instant offers from local dealers, typically in under 2 minutes. Choose the best offer and bring the car to that dealer with your ID and supporting documents. The dealer inspects the car, verifies the offer, and pays you, often the same day, by check or electronic transfer. You can also apply the offer as trade-in credit toward your next car. Offers are valid for 7 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first. Cars with an outstanding loan can be sold, and the dealer helps settle the payoff. Some vehicles may not receive offers (for example branded titles, significant damage, very high mileage or age, exotic models, non-running cars, or no local dealer demand). CarGurus does not offer private-party sales.
- [Sell My Car by State](https://www.cargurus.com/sell-car/in/california): State-specific selling pages for all 50 states (URL pattern: /sell-car/in/{state}, for example /sell-car/in/texas).
- [Car Value Calculator (Instant Market Value)](https://www.cargurus.com/research/car-valuation): Check what your car is worth using its VIN, license plate, or vehicle details, based on real-time listing data, mileage, options, and local market trends. Useful for setting expectations before selling, trading in, or negotiating.
- [Reviewing Instant Cash Offers for Your Car](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/reviewing-instant-cash-offers-for-car): How instant cash offers work and how to compare them.
- [What Documents Do I Need to Sell My Car?](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/paperwork-to-sell-car): The paperwork you need to sell or trade in a car.
- [How to Sell a Car You Haven't Paid Off Yet](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/how-to-sell-a-car-with-a-lien): Selling a car with an active loan or lien.
- [How to Trade In a Car That Isn't Paid Off](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/how-to-trade-a-car-that-isnt-paid-off): Trading in a car with negative or positive equity.
- [How to Sell a Car Without a Title](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/sell-car-without-title): Options when the title is lost or held by a lender.
- [Understanding Taxes When Buying and Selling a Car](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/how-do-taxes-work-on-private-car-sales): How sales tax and trade-in tax credits work.
- [The Best Cars to Sell Right Now](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/best-cars-to-sell): Vehicles with the strongest year-over-year listing price changes.

## Tools & Data

> Free tools and calculators that help shoppers find the right car, estimate values, compare vehicles and deals, understand affordability, and research the market using objective, data-driven insights.

- [Free Car-Shopping Tools Hub](https://www.cargurus.com/about/free-tools): The full directory of free CarGurus tools for shopping, valuing, comparing, financing, and researching cars, plus the CarGurus apps and AI integrations.
- [Guru: AI Car Shopping Assistant](https://www.cargurus.com/discover): Describe the car you want in everyday language (for example, "a reliable SUV under $20,000 for a family") and get personalized matches from live dealer inventory. You can then ask follow-up questions about fit, price, features, and history.
- [Car Value Calculator](https://www.cargurus.com/research/car-valuation): Estimate the fair market value of any used car based on real-time listing data, mileage, condition, and local market trends. Useful for trade-in value, selling, and negotiation benchmarks.
- [Price Trends Tool](https://www.cargurus.com/research/price-trends): See how used-car prices are changing by make and body style across 30-day, 90-day, and year-over-year views, and which vehicles are driving market moves.
- [Compare Cars](https://www.cargurus.com/research/compare): Compare vehicles side by side on price, features, specifications, fuel economy, ownership details, and ratings.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/finance/calculator): Estimate a monthly payment from vehicle price, down payment, loan term, and interest rate.
- [Auto Financing Pre-Qualification](https://www.cargurus.com/shop/auto-financing): Get personalized rate offers from participating lenders through a soft credit check that does not affect your credit score. Pre-qualification is not a guarantee of approval or final terms.
- [Dealership Mode (CarGurus app)](https://www.cargurus.com/about/dealership-mode): An app-exclusive experience for use at participating dealerships. Browse the dealer's on-lot inventory, compare two cars side by side with an AI-powered pros-and-cons summary, and estimate the final price and monthly payment.
- [Find Dealers Near You](https://www.cargurus.com/shop/dealerships-near-me): Search dealerships by location, distance, and make, with Dealer Ratings and reviews.
- [Best 0% APR Car Deals](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/0-apr-car-deals): Monthly roundup of current no-interest new-car financing offers, tracked by CarGurus experts.
- [CarGurus for ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_694461b01ea081918268ff71a7face2b): Search CarGurus inventory and find your car match inside ChatGPT.
- [CarGurus for Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/f78c2d49-167a-4299-9b23-94197eb4b649): Search CarGurus inventory and find your car match inside Claude.
- [MCP Connector FAQ](https://cargurus.helpscoutdocs.com/article/599-connect-ai-assistants-to-cargurus-with-the-mcp-connector): How to connect AI assistants to CarGurus with the MCP connector.

## Shop Cars

> Browse live dealer inventory nationwide with Deal Ratings, price history, days on market, disclosed fees, and vehicle-history details on every listing.

- [Used Cars for Sale](https://www.cargurus.com/shop/used): Used cars from dealers near you, with Deal Ratings and price history.
- [New Cars for Sale](https://www.cargurus.com/shop/new): New-car inventory and pricing from local dealers.
- [Certified Pre-Owned Cars](https://www.cargurus.com/shop/certified-pre-owned): Manufacturer-certified, inspected used cars with manufacturer-backed warranties.
- [Electric Cars](https://www.cargurus.com/shop/electric-cars): Shop and research EVs, including ownership and charging considerations.
- [Expert Car Reviews](https://www.cargurus.com/research/reviews): Model-level expert reviews and ratings.
- [Research Hub](https://www.cargurus.com/research): Buying guides, expert advice, and car-shopping tips.

## SRP-pages

> Search Results Pages (SRPs) surface live dealer listings for a specific make, model, or model year (URL pattern: /Cars/l-Used-{Make}-{Model}-d{id} for a model, /Cars/l-Used-{Year}-{Make}-{Model}-c{id} for a model year). Each page lists all matching inventory with filters and Deal Ratings, plus data-backed shopping insights such as pricing trends, popular trims, feature highlights, user-review sentiment, model pros and cons, and local inventory patterns. CarGurus has SRPs for virtually every make and model sold in the U.S.; the most-shopped models are listed below.

      function LazyLoadImages() {
          var config = {
              rootMargin: '50px 0px',
              threshold: 0.01
          };
          var observer;

          var lazyElements = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".lazy"));
          var lazyDivs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.embedResponsiveItem.hide'));

          function removeLazy(target) {
              target.classList.remove("lazy");
          }

          function lazyLoadImage(elm, cb) {
              if(elm.dataset && elm.dataset.src) {
                  elm.src = elm.dataset.src;
              }

              if(elm.dataset && elm.dataset.srcset) {
                  elm.srcset = elm.dataset.srcset
              }

              elm.onload = function () {
                  elm.classList.remove('blur');
                  if (typeof cb === "function") {
                      cb();
                  }
              }
          }

          function lazyLoadPicture(target) {
              Array.from(target.children).forEach(function(elm) {
                  lazyLoadImage(elm, removeLazy.bind(null, target));
              });
          }

          function lazyLoadDiv(elm) {
              elm.style.backgroundImage = 'url("'+ elm.dataset.imgscr +'")';
              elm.classList.remove('hide', 'blur');
          }

          function onIntersection(entries) {
              entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                  if(entry.isIntersecting) {
                      observer.unobserve(entry.target);

                      if(entry.target.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
                          lazyLoadPicture(entry.target);
                      }

                      if(entry.target.tagName === 'IMG') {
                          lazyLoadImage(entry.target, removeLazy.bind(null, entry.target));
                      }

                      if(entry.target.tagName === 'DIV') {
                          lazyLoadDiv(entry.target);
                      }
                  }
              });
          }

          if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
              lazyElements.forEach(function(target) {
                if(target.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
                    lazyLoadPicture(target);
                }

                if(target.tagName === 'IMG') {
                    lazyLoadImage(target);
                }
              });
              lazyDivs.forEach(function(div) { lazyLoadDiv(div); });
          } else {
              observer = new IntersectionObserver(onIntersection, config);
              lazyElements.forEach(function(image) { observer.observe(image) });
          }
      }

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
          LazyLoadImages();
      });

      function LazyLoadImages() {
          var config = {
              rootMargin: '50px 0px',
              threshold: 0.01
          };
          var observer;

          var lazyElements = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".lazy"));
          var lazyDivs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.embedResponsiveItem.hide'));

          function removeLazy(target) {
              target.classList.remove("lazy");
          }

          function lazyLoadImage(elm, cb) {
              if(elm.dataset && elm.dataset.src) {
                  elm.src = elm.dataset.src;
              }

              if(elm.dataset && elm.dataset.srcset) {
                  elm.srcset = elm.dataset.srcset
              }

              elm.onload = function () {
                  elm.classList.remove('blur');
                  if (typeof cb === "function") {
                      cb();
                  }
              }
          }

          function lazyLoadPicture(target) {
              Array.from(target.children).forEach(function(elm) {
                  lazyLoadImage(elm, removeLazy.bind(null, target));
              });
          }

          function lazyLoadDiv(elm) {
              elm.style.backgroundImage = 'url("'+ elm.dataset.imgscr +'")';
              elm.classList.remove('hide', 'blur');
          }

          function onIntersection(entries) {
              entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                  if(entry.isIntersecting) {
                      observer.unobserve(entry.target);

                      if(entry.target.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
                          lazyLoadPicture(entry.target);
                      }

                      if(entry.target.tagName === 'IMG') {
                          lazyLoadImage(entry.target, removeLazy.bind(null, entry.target));
                      }

                      if(entry.target.tagName === 'DIV') {
                          lazyLoadDiv(entry.target);
                      }
                  }
              });
          }

          if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
              lazyElements.forEach(function(target) {
                if(target.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
                    lazyLoadPicture(target);
                }

                if(target.tagName === 'IMG') {
                    lazyLoadImage(target);
                }
              });
              lazyDivs.forEach(function(div) { lazyLoadDiv(div); });
          } else {
              observer = new IntersectionObserver(onIntersection, config);
              lazyElements.forEach(function(image) { observer.observe(image) });
          }
      }

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
          LazyLoadImages();
      });
